contract_fixture_fix.reason: Vendor lock unit fixture assumed the SDK-default test argv in every runtime. It now explicitly exercises local and disposable contexts and asserts lock preparation precedes locked pub resolution, which precedes every vendor test.

publisher_ack_fixture_fix.reason: A background test thread could read the old nonce only after the next command was published, causing an unexpected timeout and late access to a removed temporary directory. The stale/failed-ACK unit case now uses a controlled clock and injects the matching failed response after command publication. Real HTTP and nonce round-trip checks remain separate.
